children.name: Pudu
children.description: Pudu — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Pudu mephistophiles
children.description: The northern pudu is a species of South American deer native to the Andes of Colombia, Venezuela, Peru and Ecuador. It is the world's smallest deer and is classified as Data Deficient in the IUCN Red List. Originally classified under genus Pudu, some authorities consider it to belong to a separate genus (Pudella) from the southern pudu, along with Pudella carlae.

children.name: Pudu puda
children.description: The southern pudu is a species of South American deer native to the Valdivian temperate forests of south-central Chile and adjacent Argentina. It is classified as Near Threatened in the IUCN Red List.

children.name: Hydropotes
children.description: Hydropotes — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Hydropotes inermis
children.description: The water deer is a small deer species native to Korea and China. It has prominent tusks, similar to those of musk deer. It was first described to the Western world by Robert Swinhoe in 1870.

children.name: Axis
children.description: Axis — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Axis axis
children.description: The chital, also called spotted deer and axis deer, is a deer species native to the Indian subcontinent. It was first described by Johann Christian Polycarp Erxleben in 1777. A moderate-sized deer, male chital reach 90 cm (35 in) and females 70 cm (28 in) at the shoulder.

children.name: Axis calamianensis
children.description: The Calamian deer, also known as Calamian hog deer, is an endangered species of deer found only in the Calamian Islands of Palawan province in the Philippines. It is one of three species of deer native to the Philippines, the other being the Philippine sambar and the Visayan spotted deer.

children.name: Axis kuhlii
children.description: The Bawean deer, also known as Kuhl's hog deer or Bawean hog deer, is a highly threatened species of deer endemic to the island of Bawean in Indonesia. Due to ongoing habitat loss, small population size and limited range, the Bawean deer is evaluated as critically endangered on the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species. It is listed on Appendix I of CITES.

children.name: Axis porcinus
children.description: The Indian hog deer, or Indochinese hog deer, is a small cervid native to the region of the Indian subcontinent and Indo-Gangetic Plain. Introduced populations are established in Australia, as well as the United States and Sri Lanka.

children.name: Elaphurus
children.description: Elaphurus — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Elaphurus davidianus
children.description: Père David's deer, also known as the milu or elaphure, is a species of deer native to the subtropical river valleys of China. It grazes mainly on grass and aquatic plants. It is the only extant member of the genus Elaphurus.

children.name: Alces
children.description: Alces — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Alces alces
children.description: The moose (: moose; used in North America) or elk (: elk or elks; used in Eurasia) (Alces alces) is the world's tallest, largest and heaviest extant species of deer and the only extant species in the genus Alces.

children.name: Alces americanus
children.description: The moose (: moose; used in North America) or elk (: elk or elks; used in Eurasia) (Alces alces) is the world's tallest, largest and heaviest extant species of deer and the only extant species in the genus Alces.

children.name: Muntiacus
children.description: Muntiacus — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Muntiacus atherodes
children.description: The Bornean yellow muntjac (Muntiacus atherodes) is a muntjac deer species, endemic to the moist forests of the island of Borneo..

children.name: Muntiacus crinifrons
children.description: The hairy-fronted muntjac or black muntjac (Muntiacus crinifrons) is a type of deer currently found in Zhejiang, Anhui, Jiangxi and Fujian in southeastern China..

children.name: Muntiacus feae
children.description: Fea's muntjac (Muntiacus feae) also called the Tenasserim muntjac, is a species of muntjac native to southern Myanmar and Thailand..

children.name: Muntiacus gongshanensis
children.description: The Gongshan muntjac (Muntiacus gongshanensis) is a species of muntjac (a type of deer) living in the Gongshan mountains in northwestern Yunnan, southeast Tibet, Northeast India (especially in Arunachal Pradesh) and northern Myanmar.

children.name: Muntiacus muntjak
children.description: The southern red muntjac (Muntiacus muntjak) is a deer species native to Southeast Asia.

children.name: Muntiacus puhoatensis
children.description: The Pu Hoat muntjac (Muntiacus puhoatensis) is a species of muntjac only known from Pu Hoat region in Vietnam, which borders Laos..

children.name: Muntiacus putaoensis
children.description: The leaf muntjac, leaf deer or Putao muntjac (Muntiacus putaoensis) is a small species of muntjac.

children.name: Muntiacus reevesi
children.description: Reeves's muntjac (Muntiacus reevesi), also known as the Chinese muntjac, is a species of muntjac found widely in south-eastern China (from Gansu to Yunnan) and Taiwan..

children.name: Muntiacus rooseveltorum
children.description: A single specimen of the Roosevelt's muntjac or Roosevelt's barking deer (Muntiacus rooseveltorum) was presented to the Field Museum in 1929 following the Kelley-Roosevelts expedition organized by Theodore (Jnr) and Kermit  Roosevelt..

children.name: Muntiacus truongsonensis
children.description: The Truong Son muntjac or Annamite muntjac (Muntiacus truongsonensis) is a species of muntjac deer..

children.name: Muntiacus vuquangensis
children.description: The giant muntjac (Muntiacus vuquangensis), sometimes referred to as the large-antlered muntjac, is a species of muntjac deer.

children.name: Cervus
children.description: Cervus — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Cervus elaphus
children.description: The red deer (Cervus elaphus) is one of the largest deer species.

children.name: Cervus hanglu
children.description: The Central Asian red deer (Cervus hanglu), also known as the Tarim red deer, is a deer species native to Central Asia, where it used to be widely distributed, but is scattered today with small population units in several countries..

children.name: Cervus megaceros
children.description: The Irish elk (Megaloceros giganteus), also called the giant deer or Irish deer, is an extinct species of deer in the genus Megaloceros and is one of the largest deer that ever lived.

children.name: Cervus nippon
children.description: The sika deer (Cervus nippon), also known as the northern spotted deer or the Japanese deer, is a species of deer native to much of East Asia and introduced to other parts of the world.

children.name: Cervus wallichii
children.description: The Tibetan red deer (Cervus canadensis wallichi) also known as shou, is a subspecies of elk/wapiti native to the southern Tibetan highlands and Bhutan..

children.name: Blastocerus
children.description: Blastocerus — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Blastocerus dichotomus
children.description: The marsh deer (Blastocerus dichotomus) is a species of deer native to South America.

children.name: Odocoileus
children.description: Odocoileus — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Odocoileus hemionus
children.description: The mule deer (Odocoileus hemionus) is a deer indigenous to western North America; it is named for its ears, which are large like those of the mule.

children.name: Odocoileus peruvianus
children.description: The white-tailed deer (Odocoileus virginianus), also known commonly as the whitetail and the Virginia deer, is a medium-sized species of deer native to North and South America..

children.name: Odocoileus virginianus
children.description: The white-tailed deer (Odocoileus virginianus), also known commonly as the whitetail and the Virginia deer, is a medium-sized species of deer native to North and South America..

children.name: Ozotoceros
children.description: Ozotoceros — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Ozotoceros bezoarticus
children.description: The Pampas deer (Ozotoceros bezoarticus) is a species of deer that live in the grasslands of South America at low elevations.

children.name: Hippocamelus
children.description: Hippocamelus — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Hippocamelus antisensis
children.description: The taruca (Hippocamelus antisensis), also known as the taruka, Peruvian guemal, north Andean deer, north Andean huemul, northern huemul or northern guemal, is a mid sized deer species that inhabits the high regions of the Andes mountains in South America..

children.name: Hippocamelus bisulcus
children.description: The south Andean deer (Hippocamelus bisulcus), also known as the southern guemal, south Andean huemul, southern huemul, or Chilean huemul or  güemul ( WAY-mool, Spanish: [weˈmul]), is an endangered species of deer native to the mountains of Argentina and Chile..

children.name: Elaphodus
children.description: Elaphodus — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Elaphodus cephalophus
children.description: The tufted deer (Elaphodus cephalophus) is a small species of deer characterized by a prominent tuft of black hair on its forehead and fang-like canines for the males.

children.name: Rucervus
children.description: Rucervus — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Rucervus duvaucelii
children.description: The barasingha (Rucervus duvaucelii), sometimes barasinghe, also known as the swamp deer, is a deer species distributed in the Indian subcontinent..

children.name: Rucervus eldii
children.description: Eld's deer (Rucervus eldii or Panolia eldii), also known as the thamin or brow-antlered deer, is an Endangered species of deer endemic to South and Southeast Asia..

children.name: Rucervus schomburgki
children.description: The Schomburgk's deer (Rucervus schomburgki) is an extinct species of deer once endemic to central Thailand..

children.name: Rusa
children.description: Rusa — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Rusa alfredi
children.description: The Visayan spotted deer (Rusa alfredi), also known as the Visayan deer, the Philippine spotted deer or Prince Alfred's deer, is a small, endangered, primarily nocturnal species of deer found in the rainforests of the Visayan Islands of Panay and Negros..

children.name: Rusa marianna
children.description: The Philippine deer (Rusa marianna), also known as the Philippine sambar or Philippine brown deer, is a vulnerable deer species endemic to the Philippines.

children.name: Rusa timorensis
children.description: The Javan rusa or Sunda sambar (Rusa timorensis) is a large deer species native to Indonesia and Timor-Leste.

children.name: Rusa unicolor
children.description: The sambar is a large deer native to the Indian subcontinent, South China and Southeast Asia. It has been listed as a vulnerable species on the IUCN Red List since 2008, as populations have declined substantially due to hunting, local insurgency, and industrial exploitation of habitat.

children.name: Antifer
children.description: Antifer — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Bretzia
children.description: Bretzia — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Bretzia nebrascensis
children.description: Bretzia nebrascensis was an extinct species of deer that lived in North America (Nebraska, South Dakota) during the Pleistocene and Early Holocene, as recently as 10,000 BP.

children.name: Bretzia pseudalces
children.description: Bretzia pseudalces, is a species of deer from the extinct genus Bretzia It is endemic to North America, with fossils found in the Ringold Formation in Washington.

children.name: Rangifer tarandus
children.description: The reindeer or caribou is a species of deer with circumpolar distribution, native to Arctic, subarctic, tundra, boreal, and mountainous regions of Northern Europe, Siberia, and North America. It is the only representative of the genus Rangifer. More recent studies suggest the splitting of reindeer and caribou.

children.name: Mazama
children.description: Mazama — a genus of deer in the family Cervidae.

children.name: Mazama americana
children.description: The red brocket (Mazama americana) is a species of brocket deer from forests in South America, ranging from northern Argentina to Colombia and the Guianas.

children.name: Mazama bororo
children.description: The small red brocket (Mazama bororo) is a small species of brocket deer in the family Cervidae..

children.name: Mazama bricenii
children.description: The Mérida brocket (Mazama bricenii), also known as the Meroia brocket or rufous brocket, is a small species of deer..

children.name: Mazama chunyi
children.description: The dwarf brocket (Subulo chunyi), or chunyi, is a small species of deer native to the Andean highlands in western Bolivia and southeastern Peru, where it is found in forest and páramo.

children.name: Mazama gouazoubira
children.description: The gray brocket (Subulo gouazoubira), also known as the brown brocket, is a species of brocket deer from northern Argentina, Bolivia, southern Peru, eastern and southern Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay.

children.name: Mazama nana
children.description: The pygmy brocket (Mazama nana) is a brocket deer species from South America.

children.name: Mazama pandora
children.description: The Yucatan brown brocket (Odocoileus pandora) is a small species of deer native to Central America..

children.name: Mazama rufina
children.description: The little red brocket or swamp brocket (Andinocervus rufinus), also known as the Ecuador red brocket, is a small, little-studied deer native to the Andes of Colombia, Ecuador and northern Peru, where found in forest and páramo at altitudes between 1,400 and 3,600 metres (4,600 and 11,800 ft)..

children.name: Mazama temama
children.description: The Central American or Mexican red brocket (Mazama temama), as it is sometimes called, is a species of brocket deer native to Mexico, Central America, and northern Colombia..

children.name: Mazama tienhoveni
children.description: The Amazonian brown brocket (Passalites nemorivagus), also known as the small brown brocket, is a small species of deer that is almost entirely restricted to South America..

children.name: Capreolus capreolus
children.description: The roe deer (Capreolus capreolus), also known as the roe, western roe deer, or European roe, is a species of deer.

children.name: Capreolus pygargus
children.description: The Siberian roe deer, eastern roe deer, or Asian roe deer (Capreolus pygargus), is a species of roe deer found in northeastern Asia..

children.name: Dama

children.name: Dama clactoniana
children.description: Dama clactoniana is an extinct species of fallow deer (genus Dama).

children.name: Dama dama
children.description: The European fallow deer (Dama dama), also known as the common fallow deer or simply fallow deer, is a species of deer native to Eurasia.

children.name: Megaloceros giganteus
children.description: The Irish elk (Megaloceros giganteus), also called the giant deer or Irish deer, is an extinct species of deer in the genus Megaloceros and is one of the largest deer that ever lived.
